thread:
Natasha (CS): FYI CalyxHealth onboarding: their account health shows rising token spend and p95 latency creep over last 72h. Renewal check in 28 days. Id like to propose a proactive perf plan.
Priya (SE): quick scan of their top 150 production prompts: candidate `redwood/galaxy-12b-int8-v2` reduces p95 ~30% and cost/unit ~25% on our bench. Semantic checks look okay, but they have a few long-form compliance prompts.
Jordan (CalyxHealth): thanks. primary concern is answer consistency for our compliance flows. any examples of regressions?
Priya (SE): only minor stylistic changes in 4/150 samples; no factual drift on the compliance subset. can share diffs in the notebook.

Maya (QA): ran random A/B for 50 samples: average semantic-sim 0.985, median unchanged. flagged 2 cases where tokenization changed phrasing (non-critical).
Leo (SRE): infra notes: Calyx traffic has burst windows at 23:00-01:00 UTC (30% of daily QPS) with ~8 concurrent heavy sessions. We're seeing KV cache churn for >600 token sequences which hurts batching.
Natasha (CS): proposal outline:
- 12h staged canary at 8% traffic to int8 model
- enable prefix/KV caching for known templates
- implement routing rule: heavy-tail (>512 tokens) -> reserved dedicated pool during peak window
- pre-configured rollback triggers for quality or error regressions
Jordan (CalyxHealth): dedicated pool during peak sounds good. SLA question: if quality dips, how fast can we rollback?
Priya (SE): automated rollback is immediate on trigger. triggers: semantic-sim drop >2.5% absolute or any increase in hallucination-rate measured by our compliance eval, or error_rate +0.4% absolute. rollback takes ~2 minutes to route.
OpsBot: deploy-plan #canary-calyx created by Priya 604; status: queued -> in_progress
DevEx: I'll publish a runnable Colab with their 150-sample set and an A/B diff viewer. we'll show side-by-side answers for the CS call.
Natasha (CS): customer-facing deliverables: 1) 1-page cost vs quality summary, 2) A/B notebook link, 3) rollback & SLA commitment doc. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Jordan.
Jordan (CalyxHealth): please include an explanation of how prefix caching interacts with user-supplied metadata (we send session context every request).
Leo (SRE): prefix caching note: we'll whitelist only verified stable prefixes and strip volatile metadata before caching. won't cache user-specific tokens.
Priya (SE): rollout steps:
1) canary 8% (12h) -> monitor latency p50/p95, token-cost, semantic-sim, hallucination checks
2) if metrics good, ramp to 40% over 6h with autoscale buffer + tracing
3) full ramp to 100% contingent on 48h stability
OpsBot: canary logs: `canary:start`, `model:galaxy-12b-int8-v2`, `cache:prefix=enabled`, `route:heavy->dedicated (peak window)`
Maya (QA): request: capture a sample set of any failed semantic-sim cases so we can inspect. also capture exact prompts that hit >512 tokens.
Natasha (CS): action items:
- Priya: deploy canary & attach A/B diff logs (ETA: today EOD)
- Leo: configure dedicated routing rule + cache whitelist (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- DevEx: publish Colab + one-pager (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- Maya: run nightly QA check on canary traffic and report failures (ETA: nightly)
- Jordan: sign off on pilot + approve dedicated pool budget (ETA: 48h)
Jordan (CalyxHealth): approved budget for the pilot. call me if we hit any compliance flags.
Natasha (CS): thanks team. aim is to reduce cost and tail latencies ahead of renewal; we'll capture feedback during the pilot and fold into renewal brief.
Priya (SE): side note: if Calyx wants more aggressive cost reductions post-pilot we can propose an int4 compact trial but only after manual QA pass.
Natasha (CS): perfect. I'll post a short recap and schedule the customer sync. :calendar:
